Title: Azure Monitor Log Analytics and Application Insights support for Availability Zones is now generally available in West US 2

Body.Content:
Azure Availability Zones provide high availability for your mission-critical applications and data. Support for this capability in Azure Monitor Log Analytics and Application Insighs means that you can now ensure achieve higher availability for your Logs in Workspace. 

More details can be found in Regions and Availability Zones in Azure.
